title: Pixel Earth's Horror Pack
description: Experience true terror with this modpack. It adds creepy monsters, terrifying sounds, and dark atmospheres to make survival harder than ever.
body:
Why This Pack Exists?
The main goal of this modpack is to save your time. Instead of spending hours searching for individual horror mods, testing them, and dealing with stability or compatibility issues, this pack delivers a fully prepared horror experience instantly.
We did all the mod sorting, optimization configurations, and performance testing for you. All you have to do is install the pack and start playing immediately.

We did all the mod sorting, optimization configurations, and performance testing for you. All you have to do is install the pack and start playing immediately.

WARNING
THIS MODPACK MAY NOT BE SUITABLE FOR EVERYONE!
AGE RATING: 13+

1.Horror & Monsters
These mods add terrifying monsters, jumpscares, and a creepy atmosphere to the world.

Another Flashlight Mod -> Adds a functional, battery-powered flashlight to guide you through pitch-black darkness.

Arthropod Phobia Expansions -> Turns spiders into giant, realistic, and terrifying horror bosses.

CANTBREATHE -> Adds intense psychological panic, breathing effects, and jumpscare elements.

Cave Dweller Evolved -> A smart, aggressive predator that stalks and hunts you inside dark caves.

From The Fog -> Brings back the Herobrine myth, making him stalk you from the distance before vanishing.

GoatMan -> A terrifying, distorted humanoid beast that hunts you down with creepy sounds.

Nyf's Spiders -> Changes spider animations to make them realistic, enabling them to crawl over walls creepy-style.

The Knocker -> A mysterious entity that stalks your base and knocks on your doors at night.

The Man From The Fog -> A tall, scary stalker creature that tracks you down under the night sky.

The Midnight Lurker -> A dark creature that watches you from shadows, multiplying the survival dread.

The One Who Watches -> An eerie entity that quietly observes you from far away hills.

The Ravenous -> A brutal, bloodthirsty monster that relentlessly attacks players.

2. Performance & Optimization
Mods that boost your FPS, fix game lag, and keep your memory usage perfectly stable.

Embeddium -> Highly optimized graphics engine that heavily boosts FPS and improves performance.

Sodium -> A modern rendering engine that improves frame rates and reduces micro-stutters.

FerriteCore -> Greatly reduces RAM usage so the game runs smoothly behind the scenes.

ImmediatelyFast -> Speeds up game rendering loops to make everything smooth during action.

Memory Leak Fix -> Automatically stops hidden memory issues, preventing long-session crashes.

ModernFix -> A utility mod loaded with performance bug fixes and launch speed upgrades.

Translations for Sodium -> Provides language translation packs designed directly for Sodium options.

3. Shaders & Visuals
These files bring custom lighting, fog configs, and cinematic visuals using Oculus.

Oculus -> The core mod that unlocks shader pack selection and settings support.

BSL Shaders / Complementary Shaders -> Gorgeous shader packs that deliver dramatic lighting, dynamic clouds, and thick horror fog.

MakeUp / Miniature / Mellow / Pastel / Potato Shaders -> A wide selection of optimized shaders ranging from basic performance looks to stylish aesthetic themes.

Default Dark Mode -> Switches your default white inventory screens into an eye-friendly dark design.

Fullbright UB -> A utility pack option used to customize lighting or brightness levels.

4. Gameplay & Utility
Mods that add useful tools, interface changes, and fun actions to vanilla gameplay.

Just Enough Items (JEI) -> Adds a helpful sidebar menu showing all item recipe layouts.

Jade -> Shows an informative tooltip pop-up detailing exactly what block or mob you are looking at.

Sound Physics Remastered -> Upgrades sound processing to feature custom cave echoes and dynamic audio bouncing.

VeinMiner -> Allows you to mine entire veins of ores in one swift click, speeding up resource gathering.

Geckolib / playerAnimator -> Essential core libraries that handle advanced custom models and fluid mob animation movements.
